exceptions.justification: CodeRabbit reviews pull requests as a GitHub App; its CLI is not run inside the CI contract job.
exceptions.ruleBroken: CodeRabbit findings must be addressed or recorded before merge.
exceptions.attempted: Running the CodeRabbit CLI in the workflow, which needs a CodeRabbit API key that is not issued to CI.
exceptions.constraint: In CI the review is the GitHub App's; the CLI only reviews uncommitted local edits.
exceptions.whyPreferable: The App's review threads are resolved on the pull request before merge, so its findings still block.
exceptions.residualRisk: A finding the App never raised is not seen; the same is true of any reviewer.
exceptions.revisitWhen: CodeRabbit ships a CI mode for the CLI, or the App is uninstalled.

exceptions.justification: The generated API site renders the file name VERSIONING.md as a link to the host versioning.md, which is not a real link target.
exceptions.attempted: Looked for the source of the link in tracked files; it exists only in generated site output, not in any authored document.
exceptions.constraint: The link is produced by the documentation generator's autolinking of a bare file name, so it cannot be fixed in a source file.
exceptions.whyPreferable: Disabling external link checking would also stop real broken links from being reported.
exceptions.residualRisk: None for the shipped package: the text is a file name, not a reference a reader is meant to follow.
exceptions.revisitWhen: The documentation generator stops autolinking bare file names, or the file name is written inside backticks.
